comment: Every difference between doors that the door contracts allow. An entry is a fact, a reason and an owner. See harness/doors/compare.ts.

differences.why: A box exports with its own command (`parachute-vault export`); cloud-style doors stream the same files from `GET /api/export`. The files are the same (compared under exit/file.*). A box gets the HTTP exit with 0.9.3.
